_readme: Day-of location drop. Leave active false until drop time. At drop time set active true and fill in the show. The site only shows it once revealAt has passed, but anyone can read this file after it is pushed, so push it at drop time, not before. GitHub Pages can take up to 10 minutes to serve a change. mapX/mapY place the X on the Home map (the map is 2000 by 1600; City Hall is 1150,700). crew is optional and shows in a collapsed Crew load-in section.
